aunt_zhang_dialogue.name: Background
aunt_zhang_dialogue.text:
Aunt Zhang is a bakery owner. 
She wants to expand her business and apply for a loan.

aunt_zhang_dialogue.name: Background
aunt_zhang_dialogue.text: Unfortunately, the bank rejected her request.

aunt_zhang_dialogue.name: Aunt Zhang
aunt_zhang_dialogue.title: Bakery Owner
aunt_zhang_dialogue.text: I went to bank and try to apply for loan,  the bank staff said that i should apply it online and approved by AI.

aunt_zhang_dialogue.name: Aunt Zhang
aunt_zhang_dialogue.title: Bakery Owner
aunt_zhang_dialogue.text: It said I do not have income source!

aunt_zhang_dialogue.name: Aunt Zhang
aunt_zhang_dialogue.title: Bakery Owner
aunt_zhang_dialogue.text: I just <yellow>keep my cash in the iron box under my bed!</yellow>
